items.text: In portal messages sent to clinicians at the participating clinics, what are the sensitivity and specificity of the vendor's automated urgent-message flag, run in silent mode, against an adjudicated two-clinician reference standard, overall, by clinic and by message language?
items.population: Randomly sampled portal messages to clinicians at the participating clinics
items.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity for messages needing same-day attention

finer: Feasible with the quality budget and reviewing clinicians; interesting to clinicians and the vendor; novel locally and by language; ethical with privacy approval and silent mode; relevant to the switch-on decision.
